steps.hardClue: Repair the ziplines and complete the totem challenges.
steps.clue: Repair the ziplines and complete all challenges from two of the Hermit’s Challenge Totems.

steps.hardClue: Place the four dials in storage, then collect three offerings from the riddles.
steps.clue: Place the Hermit’s four dials in Artifact Storage, then collect the three Apothicon offerings.

steps.hardClue: Follow the final riddle and use explosives to open the hidden safe.
steps.clue: Follow the Apothicon’s final riddle and blast open the safe containing the Seal of Duality.

steps.hardClue: Freeze and return three scattered orbs, then purify the Seal at the campfire.
steps.clue: Freeze and return the three orange orbs, then purify the Seal with Samantha’s Music Box.

steps.hardClue: Heat and cool the two stones, then use them to obtain a fuse.
steps.clue: Heat and cool the two Soapstones, then use them to obtain the fuse.

steps.hardClue: Power the sealed door, then recover the shard inside.
steps.clue: Power the Lighthouse Station door and recover the Elemental Shard.

steps.hardClue: Return the shard, repeat the three-orb ritual, then purify the Seal again.
steps.clue: Return the Elemental Shard, repeat the orange-orb ritual, then purify the Seal again.

steps.hardClue: Give the Seal to the man above and survive the lockdown.
steps.clue: Give the Seal of Duality to the Hermit and survive the Lighthouse lockdown.

steps.hardClue: Charge the Seal at all four Pack-a-Punch locations, then purify it again.
steps.clue: Charge the Seal of Duality at the four Pack-a-Punch machines, then purify it again.

steps.hardClue: Charge the Seal at the golden machine, then stay inside its shield as it crosses the map.
steps.clue: Charge the Seal at Golden Pack-a-Punch, then follow its shield through the collapsing map.

steps.hardClue: Return the Seal, then retrieve the completed device from the ship.
steps.clue: Return the Seal of Duality to the Hermit, then retrieve the Agarthan Device at the Forecastle.
